long_biography.plain_text:
Property administration became Gérard Naigeon's most enduring business activity. He managed Saviguy and held partner-manager roles across several civil-property entities, combining ownership duties with day-to-day legal responsibility. He also directed Colbert Participations, an industrial, property and financial holding business based in Saint-Cloud.

Naigeon's earlier leadership extended into manufacturing through Tissextra, a long-established hosiery producer. He later oversaw the firm's liquidation after it had ceased operating. The contrast between that industrial role and his continuing property mandates shows a career moving from textile and holding-company administration towards stewardship of a family-linked cluster of real-estate vehicles.

Real Estate is a medium-confidence inference from several continuing manager and partner-manager positions in active property entities, contrasted with liquidated or ceased textile and Colbert companies.
